Case note: C.C. No. 1530/2019
Client: Neha Chauhan (general physician, New Delhi)
Opposing party: Pioneer Builders Pvt Ltd
Court: New Delhi District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
Filed on: 9 June 2019
Claim amount: ₹3,77,00,000
Issue: consumer complaint. The builder keeps promising possession by email but never delivers.
Advice given: Keep every written promise of possession because each one extends the period of limitation.
Outcome: The complaint was admitted and notice was issued to the builder.
Recommended next step: File the evidence affidavit.
